text:
mario: quick q on streaming shape for function/tool calls — do we need to support incremental func params (chunked) or just stream the arguments as content and emit a final function_call? cc @anika @sophia

anika: short answer: we should allow deltas for params. long json args benefit a lot from chunking. but keep a single canonical final function_call for compatibility :+1:

sophia: agree with deltas but worried about legacy clients that only handle a single final `function_call` object. proposal: emit partial deltas with `type: \"func_delta\"` then a final `type: \"func_call\"` with `complete: true` so old clients ignore deltas and only process the final message. :thinking:

mario: can you paste a minimal example of the delta + final? trying to capture exact keys we want.

anika: here’s a rough streaming example (model -> client chunks):
```json
// streaming chunks
{ "type": "func_delta", "name": "update_user", "chunk": "{\\\"id\\\":\\\"123\\\",\\\"meta\\\":\"" }
{ "type": "func_delta", "chunk": "...rest of json..." }
{ "type": "func_call", "name": "update_user", "args": "{\\\"id\\\":\\\"123\\\",\\\"meta\\\":{...}}", "complete": true }
```

sophia: small nit: streaming raw json strings can break incremental parsers if fragments slice multibyte chars. recommend either well-formed json fragments or a `is_json_fragment:true` flag so clients know how to reassemble.

leo: runtime perspective: prefer simple text chunks + `chunk_seq` so we can verify order. base64 is doable but adds CPU. propose `chunk_seq` (int) + `chunk_count` optional. also include `trace_id` on each piece for audit.

anika: ok final proposal (for the spec PR):
- Add `func_delta` event: fields = `type: \"func_delta\"`, `name` (string), `chunk` (string), `chunk_seq` (int), `is_json_fragment` (bool), `trace_id` (string)
- Final `func_call` event: `type: \"func_call\"`, `name`, `args` (full string), `complete: true`, `trace_id`
- Keep `role`/`name` semantics on root messages only; deltas do not need `role`.
- Add `redact` flag for deltas to mark PII (logged but masked)

mario: any security/audit concerns with partial args being emitted earlier? could leak sensitive tokens if not redacted.

sophia: yes — require `trace_id` and recording; add policy that streaming deltas are logged with masking by default. also allow `redact:true` so caller can mark sensitive fields.

leo: runtime note: we’ll add a deployment-level feature flag `streaming.func_params_chunking` for backward compatibility so customers can disable chunking if they have legacy clients. fallback will emit only final `func_call` (no deltas).

mario: great. can someone open a tiny PR with the spec + examples and ping eng-runtime for review? tagging @leo

leo: I will. aiming EOD. I’ll include unit tests that reject unordered `chunk_seq` and missing `trace_id`.

dev-bot: CI: build 4521 on branch streaming-func-deltas reported: parser-test flaky — re-run requested. @leo

leo: saw the failure, re-ran the job. :thumbsup:

anika: thanks all — i’ll add this to the API contract doc under `messages.tool_call_streaming` and link the PR when it’s up.

mario: perfect. tagging @sophia for audit signoff once PR is up.
